# Avital Experiences

> > Curated food tours, private dining experiences, and interactive team building events across major US cities including San Francisco, NYC, and Denver.

Avital Experiences specializes in culinary-focused corporate events and group experiences, offering everything from hands-on cocktail classes to guided food tours. Founded by Avital Ungar with a partnership with World Central Kitchen, the company delivers both in-person and virtual team building activities centered around food and beverage.

## Key Topics

- Food tours
- Private dining
- Corporate team building
- Virtual experiences
- Group dining
- Mixology and cocktail classes
- San Francisco dining
- NYC restaurants
- Denver venues
- Event planning
- Restaurant guides
- Remote team building
- Cooking classes
- José Andrés
- World Central Kitchen

- [Hands-On Cocktail Bar | Avital Experiences](https://avitalexperiences.com/experiences/hands-on-cocktail-bar): Interactive mixology experience with expert bartender-guided cocktails
- [Expert Guide to Private Dining in Denver | Avital](https://avitalexperiences.com/denver/private-dining): Denver private dining guide covering RiNo and Downtown restaurant venues
- [Virtual Tricks and Treats | Virtual Halloween Experience | Avital](https://avitalexperiences.com/experiences/virtual-tricks-treats): Virtual Halloween cocktail class with miracle berries flavor tripping
